questions.question: How does the book of Malachi open?
options: With God saying, 'I have loved you,' though the people question it
With an urgent call to rebuild the broken-down and ruined temple
With God pronouncing utter and complete destruction upon all Judah
With a great vision of the four mighty and terrible beasts of the sea
questions.answer: With God saying, 'I have loved you,' though the people question it

questions.question: What did God rebuke the priests for offering on the altar?
Malachi 1 says God's name will be great among the nations, from the rising of the sun to its setting.
'I have _____ you,' says the LORD. But you say, 'How have you loved us?'
When you offer blind animals in sacrifice, is that not _____? says the LORD.
